about: Modwerk source-only temp-save package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/temp-save.

mods.title: Temp Save
mods.summary: FUNC + YES overwrites the pattern's and kit's saved copies, the ones stock's reloads go back to; FUNC + NO brings both back.
mods.description: Try something on the Rytm and get back to where you were. FUNC + YES saves the active pattern and its kit, performance and scene locks included, over their saved copies, with stock's own save. FUNC + NO reloads both. A save belongs to its pattern and kit: change either or load a project and FUNC + NO shows NO TEMP SAVE.
mods.author: npp1993
mods.on_unit: On an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, as reported by the author: build TS09 (Temp Save alone) passed FUNC + YES and FUNC + NO for the pattern, kit, performance and scene locks, beside stock's own saves and reloads. This package's own bytes have not been flashed from the site.
